commands.name: spec-typecheck
commands.run: quint typecheck spec/quint/billing_sync.qnt && quint typecheck spec/quint/billing_sync_2ev.qnt

commands.name: spec-sim
commands.run: for i in convPayloadAtomic convFetchLwwAtomic convFetchGuardAtomic convFetchTieAtomic convPayloadKv convFetchGuardKv convFetchTieKv neverAhead; do echo ===$i; quint run spec/quint/billing_sync_2ev.qnt --invariant=$i --max-steps=12 --max-samples=20000 2>&1 | grep -E 'violation|No violation'; done

commands.name: spec-verify
commands.run: for i in convPayloadAtomic convFetchLwwAtomic convFetchGuardAtomic convFetchTieAtomic convPayloadKv convFetchGuardKv convFetchTieKv neverAhead; do echo ===$i; quint verify spec/quint/billing_sync_2ev.qnt --invariant=$i --max-steps=12 2>&1 | tail -2; done
